scope: Cross-industry risk identification, analysis/quantification, evaluation, treatment-option ranking, monitoring and vertical specialization.
non_collapse_laws: risk-treatment ranking != authorization or executed mitigation
required_resolution: Adjudicate whether a reusable risk lifecycle bounded context is justified and define one-way vertical specializations; do not promote finance, safety or cybersecurity vocabulary into universal semantics.

scope: Stress-testing study design, scenario/sensitivity/reverse-stress variants, governance, severity, scope and result interpretation across domains.
non_collapse_laws: bank stress-testing governance cannot be silently universalized to every industry
required_resolution: Define a domain-neutral method kernel only for invariant stress-testing semantics, with vertical profiles for banking, insurance, engineering, resilience and other domains.

scope: The unqualified verb decompose does not name what object, algebra, model or explanation is decomposed.
required_resolution: Each vertical occurrence must bind an exact decomposition method family or retain no_match; no generic decomposition operation is permitted.

scope: The unqualified verb segment is ambiguous among statistical clustering, image segmentation, market/customer segmentation, spatial partitioning and rule-based cohorting.
required_resolution: Bind each vertical occurrence to an exact segmentation/cohort/partition method or keep a typed no-match.

scope: The verb fit requires an exact model family, objective/loss, estimator, constraints and diagnostics.
required_resolution: Bind occurrences through ctx.study.estimator_method to an exact method/estimator contract.

scope: Model calibration requires an exact model family, calibration target/observations, objective or likelihood, parameter authority, uncertainty and validation criteria.
required_resolution: Bind occurrences through ctx.study.estimator_method and ctx.study.result_evaluation to an exact calibration protocol.

scope: Sensitivity and uncertainty analysis require explicit varied inputs/assumptions, uncertainty relation, propagation/evaluation method and result qualification criteria.
required_resolution: Bind through ctx.study.result_evaluation to exact sensitivity and uncertainty method profiles; use optimization-specific primitives only when the subject is an optimization solution.

scope: Bottleneck localization may mean process throughput constraint, queue/capacity bottleneck, physical network restriction, causal constraint or optimization shadow-price diagnosis.
non_collapse_laws: binding optimization constraint != observed operational bottleneck
required_resolution: Resolve vertical occurrences to the correct process/queue/network/optimization method family.

scope: State reconstruction requires a declared state model, observation model, temporal cut and uncertainty semantics.
non_collapse_laws: reconstructed latent state != observed source state
required_resolution: Bind through ctx.study.estimator_method to a domain/model-specific state-estimation or reconstruction contract.

scope: Ranking candidate explanations requires a defined hypothesis space, evidence relation, score/comparison rule and uncertainty/causal posture.
required_resolution: Bind each occurrence to an exact diagnostic/explanation method and preserve decision handoff separately.

scope: Robustness checks require the perturbation set, assumptions varied, invariants/acceptance thresholds and failure interpretation.
required_resolution: Bind through ctx.study.result_evaluation to an exact robustness/sensitivity protocol.

scope: Scenario comparison requires scenario identity, common objectives/measures, uncertainty relation, feasibility posture and comparison rule.
required_resolution: Bind through study/result-evaluation and the selected simulation/planning method family.

scope: Generic compare/decompose/rank-contributors labels in health and finance omit the compared object, decomposition algebra and contribution relation.
required_resolution: Resolve per occurrence through case design, estimator/method and result evaluation; retain no-match where qualifiers are absent.
